narration: The average American spends $1,463 on holiday gifts this season. Here's the number nobody's ever calculated — and it'll change how you shop.
visual: Three shopping bags with handles spring up from bottom in staggered sequence (amber / dark amber / brown). Dollar counter animates from $0 to $1,463 in large amber text. Subtitle fades in at bottom.

narration: Cornell researchers found gift recipients value presents at just fifty cents for every dollar you spend. You bought love — they kept half the receipt.
visual: Gift box SVG (amber with brown bow and ribbon) springs in on light background. Two price tags appear: YOU SPEND $100 on left with strikethrough, THEY VALUE AT $50 on right connected by arrow.

narration: 36% of Americans go into debt just for holiday gifts. They'll spend all of February paying it off — plus interest they never counted.
visual: Dark background. Credit card SVG with red accent stripe springs in with rotation. Large red 36% stat springs in. Progress bar fills to 36% mark. Subtitle fades in about February.

narration: Here's what changes if you invest that $1,463 instead. At 7% a year for 30 years — it grows to $147,500. That's the real price tag on your gift list.
visual: Light background. 6 bars grow sequentially left to right (Yr 5 through Yr 30). Dollar counter climbs from $1,463 to $147,500 above the bars in large amber text.

narration: That $147,500 is a home down payment, four years of college, or five extra years of retirement. You gave it away one Amazon box at a time.
visual: Dark background. Three icons spring in staggered: house (triangle roof + rectangle body), diploma scroll with star seal, palm tree with trunk and leaves. Labels below each icon.

narration: This year, propose a $20 gift cap to your family. It feels weird for about two minutes — then everyone's relieved. Follow for more money moves.
visual: Light background. Pink piggy bank SVG with amber coin slot. Coins drop in one by one above the slot. '$20 GIFT CAP PER PERSON' text animates in. CTA line fades in at bottom.
